summary: Lookout tower at a CCC camp on Rose Bay in the Swanquarter refuge; NGS datasheet (1935-1985) describes a 90-ft tower. No source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1935 description puts the tower on the west side of Rose Bay; the 1949 description puts it on the northeast shore. Both are on Rose Bay and the datasheet does not reconcile them.

sources.title: Anthony Troy Elliott Photo Collection, PhC.113

notes_for_editor: Identity is the main open question. The NGS datasheet calls the structure a lookout tower at a CCC camp on Rose Bay, inside the refuge, and tnlandforms files it as NCT223. The Forest Lookouts North Carolina list has no Swanquarter entry, and no source read calls it a fire tower, so the story claims no fire use. The Camp Redington link (source 3) is an inference from place and date; the datasheet does not name the camp. The two NGS descriptions disagree on the side of Rose Bay (1935 west, 1949 northeast). The 1935 entry also gives a signal height of 26 m above the station mark, which is not the same measure as the 90-ft tower figure; it is not used. Record coordinates (35.43417, -76.39722) match the datasheet position to about 0.0001 degree, so no correction. Access is left unset because no source says whether the tower can be visited. No source describes the site today; the refuge page does not mention the tower.
